description: Na₂CaVP₂O₉ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra,  a faceface with one VO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-61°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.64 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.68 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-2.22 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent VO₆ octahedra and corners with six equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-44°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-54°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one V, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one P atom.
